name: citation
title: Citation
description: A small numbered mark in a sentence that points at its source.
use: A numbered mark at the end of a claim that leads to where the claim came from: an entry in a list of sources, or a popover with the source's title. Write it with no space before it, so it wraps with the word it follows.

instead.when: Words of the sentence themselves lead somewhere
The sentence names a person, a team or a thing

keyboard.action: Follows the link to the source in the list, as the native element does
On a button with popovertarget: opens and closes the popover with the source

classes.name: citation
classes.description: The mark: an <a> whose href is the source's id, or a <button> with popovertarget written directly before its popover. Give it an aria-label such as "Source 2"

states.name: expanded
states.description: The source it opens is showing: the mark fills with ink

states.name: current
states.description: The mark a reader has just followed: filled with ink

states.name: popover open
states.description: The popover written directly after the mark is open: filled with ink, with no attribute to set

example:
Corners are drawn as squircles where the browser supports them.1
